currentCoordinate.coordNote: Candidate marker retained. Official sources resolve the 1971 relocation to Praça Etelvina Luz and newer municipal usage of Praça Nereu Ramos, but an exact stable current geometry/source object is still required.

identity.resolvedIdentity: Current Monumento ao Mineiro in the Praça Etelvina Luz sector of the central Praça Nereu Ramos system
identity.identityProblem: The monument was inaugurated in 1946 in front of Catedral São José and moved in 1971 to Praça Etelvina Luz. Newer municipal communication also describes the current site as Praça Nereu Ramos.
identity.splitReason: The current monument and original 1946 position are historical phases of one moved object, not two active places.

requiredEvidence: stable current monument object or exact memorial geometry
current coordinate plotted in the post-1971 location
historical note preserving the original 1946 cathedral-front location

evidence.sourceName: Fundação Cultural de Criciúma – Inventário do Monumento ao Mineiro
evidence.finding: The official inventory states that the monument opened in Praça Nereu Ramos in 1946 and was transferred to Praça Etelvina Luz in 1971, where it remains.
evidence.reason: The inventory resolves the relocation but does not expose exact current geometry.

evidence.sourceName: Fundação Cultural de Criciúma – 2025 revitalization notice
evidence.finding: The 2025 municipal notice confirms the same 1971 relocation and describes the revitalized current monument within Praça Nereu Ramos.
evidence.reason: Current area naming is confirmed, but a stable monument point or geometry is still absent.

decision.blockedReason: The relocation and current area are officially documented, but the exact current monument geometry has not been captured.
decision.nextAction: Resolve a stable current POI/object or plot the memorial geometry in the post-1971 position; preserve the original site only as history.

notes: The foundation text incorrectly implied a static location at the original square front; the place content is corrected in this batch.
Praça Etelvina Luz and newer Praça Nereu Ramos usage must be documented as an area-naming history, not treated as contradictory active monuments.
